verdict.rationale: Mesh documents an API-driven screening lifecycle: you create and screen a customer synchronously or asynchronously, poll the Get Status and Result of Onboarding API or receive a WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhook, and retrieve hits, alerts and cases via the API. An OpenAPI schema and Postman collection are also offered. Nothing in the evidence covers captured media retrieval or cancelling, deleting or redacting a verification, so only part of the lifecycle is shown. Missing for 10: captured media retrieval endpoints, cancel/redact/delete operations, documentation of every lifecycle step, independent or hands-on corroboration.
